notes: Transfer line rises continuously from manifold to C-101 - no pockets (2-phase flow).

Neutraliser / filming amine injection quills within 1.5 m of column nozzle (X-103).

Pump nozzle 10" assumed (API 610 vendor data pending).
Line exits C-101 skirt through 1000 mm access sleeve; hot (390 C) - skirt opening insulated.
NPSHa per mech. data sheet; suction line kept short (< 15 m developed per pump).
